name: WhatTheAI

sources.title: Advertise Your AI Tool - sponsorships & featured listings

requirements: AI tools only - huge taxonomy (34k+ tools, 278 categories per third-party listing)
Account required to submit and manage listings (per third-party sources; submit page itself is JS-rendered)
Manual review process; freemium model - free standard listing, paid featured placement via /advertise
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, category from their taxonomy, and logo/screenshots
Have the marketing copy reflect real AI functionality
workflow: Complete the tool submission form (name, link, description, category)
Wait for manual approval; paid featured options live under /advertise
watchFor: The /submit page did not render its form to a plain fetch (JS app) - use a browser
Dofollow status of free links is not disclosed; third-party catalogs disagree
Featured/paid placement is a separate product - do not confuse advertising checkout with the free submission
Approval time is unspecified; allow for manual review delays
countsAsLive: The tool has a public /tools/<slug> page on whattheai.tech reachable from its category listing.
unknowns: Exact form fields and whether submission is gated differently post-login
Pricing details of the featured options (advertise page exists but prices unverified)
